text_block_list.text: On the way back from an outdoor run...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ah... the light turned red again...
I'm sorry, Onii-sama.
choice_data_list: It's not your fault, Rice Shower.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ah... the light turned red again...
I'm sorry, Onee-sama.
choice_data_list: It's not your fault, Rice Shower.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: B-But... this is already the fifth time...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Even today's running route had to be changed from the usual
due to a sudden road closure in the first place...

text_block_list.name: Greengrocer Uncle
text_block_list.text: —Whoa?! If it isn't Rice Shower-chan over there?!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Fweh!?

text_block_list.name: Greengrocer Uncle
text_block_list.text: Whoops, sorry to startle ya! Having a star Umamusume right in front of me just caught me off guard...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: A s-star Umamusume? Rice...?

text_block_list.name: Greengrocer Uncle
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah! Thanks to you, this year's Takarazuka Kinen
was the best dream I could've asked for!
...Oh, right! Take this with you!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huh!?

text_block_list.name: Greengrocer Uncle
text_block_list.text:
Daikon radishes are in season right now!
Eat up, and give it your all in the Arima Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I-Is it really okay for me
to accept this much...?

I look inside the bag she's holding. The daikon radish
she was given shines as if polished, looking truly delicious.
choice_data_list: This would be delicious if made into simmered daikon~
This would be delicious if made into simmered daikon~

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ! Simmered daikon radish...

text_block_list.name: Gal A
text_block_list.text:
...Wait!?
Isn't that the real Rice Shower?!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Fweh!?

text_block_list.name: Gal A
text_block_list.text:
—Alright, that's mochi for ya!
Though it's just leftovers from the mochi-pounding festival!

text_block_list.name: Gal B
text_block_list.text:
You've got another race coming up soon, right?
I'm suuuuper hyped for the Winning Live! Later!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I... I got some mochi too...
choice_data_list: Sounds good, maybe I'll make some oshiruko.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Oshiruko...!

text_block_list.name: Izakaya Owner
text_block_list.text:
Sorry that it's yellowtail meant for the shop, but take it!
It's great grilled, and great as shabu-shabu too!
Good luck in your race!

text_block_list.name: Local Woman
text_block_list.text:
"Take some Napa cabbage from our field!
You're so skinny, make sure you eat properly, okay? Do your best!"
Perhaps because it was obvious I was carrying refreshments, I continued to receive various gifts wherever I went afterwards—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Heave-ho... Whew.
We really got so much, didn't we, Big Brother?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Heave-ho... Whew.
We really got so much, didn't we, Big Sister?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
They all look so delicious, I can't wait to eat them...!
What kind of dish should I make?
choice_data_list: Hmm. Let me see...
Hmm. That's true...

text_block_list.text: Crossing my arms... I look at the mountain of refreshments I received today sitting at my feet.
Every single one is in-season and at its peak, and they'd surely be delicious cooked separately, but when it comes down to it—
choice_data_list: How about throwing all the refreshments into a hot pot?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"Is it ready yet, is it ready yet? Bubbling hot pot...♪
Dear Brother's special hot pot...♪"
choice_data_list: Alright, that should be enough—I'm opening it!
Okay, I think that's enough—I'm opening it!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"Is it ready yet, is it ready yet? Bubbling hot pot...♪
Dear Sister's special hot pot...♪"
choice_data_list: Alright, that should be enough—I'm opening it!
Okay, I think that's enough—I'm opening it!

text_block_list.text:
Holding the earthenware pot's lid with a towel, I popped it open.
Instantly, a gentle plume of white steam spread throughout the room.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Fwaah~!
It smells so full of broth and vegetables...!
choice_data_list: Now that's a hot pot loaded with ingredients!
It's become a hot pot loaded with ingredients!

text_block_list.text:
I carefully ladle out the pot that's bubbling almost to the brim
and place a bowl in front of each of them.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Big Brother!
Well then... thank you for the food!
choice_data_list: Thanks for the food!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Big Sister!
Well then... thank you for the food!
choice_data_list: Thanks for the food!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
*blow* *blow*...
...*chomp!*

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Mmm~! So delithious~~...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I can taste all the different kinds of broth.
The ginger really gives it a kick, too... it warms you right up!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: It's truly so warm and cozy...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"...I didn't expect it to turn out
to be such a warm and sunny day."
choice_data_list: Hm?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I caused you so much trouble, Big Brother,
so I thought it was just a terrible day...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I caused so much trouble for you, Big Sister,
so I thought today was just a total failure...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Still—
"This would make an exquisite furofuki daikon~"
"This would make an exquisite furofuki daikon, wouldn't it~"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: "Still, so many people gave me care packages, and Big Brother turned them all into a delicious hot pot for me."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: "Still, so many people gave me care packages, and Big Sister turned them all into a delicious hot pot for me."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
And then, you know...
all my sad feelings just vanished somewhere.
choice_data_list: Food really is incredible!
Food really is incredible!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...You know, it's not just food.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: You too, Big Brother!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: You too, Big Sister!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Because you're here, Big Brother...
Eating meals brings me so, so much happiness.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Because you're here, Big Sister...
I can feel so, so happy over a meal.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: "So let's keep eating lots of delicious food together with Rice, okay...?"
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's eat a ton!
Yeah, let's eat a ton!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
You know, when spring comes, I'd love to go
foraging for wild greens again and eat dishes made with them.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
In the summer, I want to try flowing somen noodles.
And in autumn, I want to make sweets inspired by new picture books...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: And also, and also—
